column1: # The RK3576 Windows driver package: which driver goes onto which board.
# One line per driver folder of the package (drivers\<dir>). Columns, separated
# by tabs or spaces:
#   dir       the folder in the package, and the name the boards\ lists use
#   default   boards it is installed on by default: "all", a comma list of
#             board ids (tspi3m, cm5io, rock4d), or "-"
#   optional  boards it is installed on only on request (install.cmd /optional,
#             Maskrom Studio: never), or "-"
#   from      where it comes from: woa (built from this repository by
#             build-woa.ps1 in the same drivers.yml run), gpu (wddm-mali-g52),
#             npu (woa-rk3576-npu)
#   os        optional: which Windows builds it is for. "win10" (below
#             22000; Windows 10 is 19041 to 19045 here), "win11" (22000 and
#             later), "N-" (build N and later, e.g. 26100- for a driver that
#             needs 24H2) or "N-M". ":<dir>" after it says the row is the
#             build of <dir> for those builds (dwc_eqos10 is dwc_eqos for
#             Windows 10). Left out, every Windows. install.cmd and
#             install-online.ps1 install the rows that cover the target's
#             build and name each driver that has no build for it.
#   what      what it is, for the manifest and the lists
# A driver for hardware a board does not have binds nothing, because each INF
# matches only an ACPI ID that edk2-rk3576 publishes on the boards (and with the
# options) that have the device. The board columns keep the lists honest anyway:
# a board gets only what can be on it.
# dir        default        optional  from   [os]   what
dwcsdhc      all            -         woa    eMMC (dwcsdhc)
dwcmshc      all            -         woa    SD card and SDIO (dwcmshc)
rk3xgpio     all            -         woa    GPIO
rk3xi2c      all            -         woa    I2C
pl330dma     all            -         woa    DMA (PL330)
dwc_eqos     all            -         woa    win11  Ethernet (GMAC)
dwc_eqos10   all            -         woa    win10:dwc_eqos  Ethernet (GMAC), NetAdapterCx 2.0 build for Windows 10
rk3xspi      all            -         woa    SPI
vdpu383      all            -         woa    Video decoder (VDPU383)
rk3xsaradc   all            -         woa    ADC keys and headphone detect (SARADC)
rk3xuart     all            -         woa    40-pin UART
rk806pwrkey  cm5io,rock4d   -         woa    Power button (RK806)
rkled        all            -         woa    Board LEDs
rkeeprom     rock4d         -         woa    HAT EEPROM (ROCK 4D)
gt9271       tspi3m         -         woa    Touch screen (GT9271)
bcm4345bt    tspi3m         cm5io     woa    Bluetooth (BCM4345C5; CM5-IO BCM4362A2 untested)
rk3xi2sbus   all            -         woa    Audio: SAI bus
csaudiork3x  all            -         woa    Audio: HDMI and codec endpoints
es8323       all            -         woa    Audio: ES8388 codec
rk3576-null  all            -         woa    No-driver devices (RK806, pin controller, RTC, UART2, PCIe DBI), named
maliwddm     all            -         gpu    GPU (Mali-G52, maliwddm, with the D3D and OpenGL user-mode drivers)
malivop      all            -         gpu    Display controller name (VOP2, null driver)
rknpu        all            -         npu    NPU (rknpu)
